plainName: Interest on an electric vehicle loan
summary: Interest payable on a loan from a financial institution to buy an electric vehicle is deducted up to a limit, where the loan was sanctioned within the window the Act sets. The same interest may not be deducted anywhere else. Only the old regime allows it.

routes.name: A loan for an electric vehicle
routes.description: The interest payable in the year, up to the limit.

disqualifiers.description: It is not deducted in the default regime.
A loan sanctioned outside the window.
The same interest claimed under any other provision, such as house property, is not checked yet.
